name: l11-ipv6-binary-write-v2
purpose: Legacy binary v2 write (astra turn-3): -6 selects the IPv6 binary format (header 'binary format v2.0 ipv6'); discriminating address bytes (2001:db8::1 and 2001:db8::8000:0:0:0:1) survive the round-trip exactly, and both engines write identical v2 bytes (hashed across engines).
